name: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon
description:
About This Game

Your ship and crew are ready to dive into deep and dangerous space, deliver cargo and fulfill tasks across the far reaches of the cosmos. During your journey, you will encounter enemies, new allies, and mysterious disaster sites.

What do the distant stars hide? An unknown alien threat has shattered the fragile peace, the Trade Federation scrambles to maintain order, and pirates rule the trade routes. You are a space trucker navigating the endless horizon – each day brings one choice, and every choice shapes your fate. Survival isn't guaranteed. It's earned.

Every turn is a new day in space, bringing random encounters and tough choices. Accept cargo contracts and haul shipments across dangerous sectors — the riskier the route, the greater the reward. Fight spaceships in tactical turn-based combat where you target ship components for strategic advantages. Explore abandoned stations, answer distress calls, or seize trading opportunities. Something's always happening.

Shape your ship to match your playstyle. Upgrade hulls, weapons, shields, and cargo capacity. Recruit crew – each role matters. Commanders sharpen your aim in battle, Navigators guide you to opportunities, Engineers patch hull breaches. Just keep your crew paid. 

Beyond ongoing jobs, narrative quests reveal the galaxy's secrets. Each sector offers unique story chains with branching paths – your choices determine outcomes. Mediate faction conflicts, expose conspiracies, or help communities survive. Some decisions shift only the story, others transform entire regions and unlock new possibilities.
short_desc: Embark on a Sci-fi Roguelike Turn-based RPG with Tactical combat. Become a Captain of a freight ship, deliver cargo through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, fight space warships, and build your reputation. Every day brings a new adventure. Space shows no mercy.
